**Austria: scale and change.** Across 2000–2025, the extract records 753,700 applications. The largest annual volume was 109,773 in 2022; 2025 recorded 16,635. Applications in 2025 were 29% higher than in 2019 (12,853). In 2025, 20,754 recorded decisions equated to 125 per 100 applications, so recorded output exceeded incoming volume. Applications in 2025 were 34% lower than in 2024 (25,322). Applications exceeded recorded decisions in 2 of 5 comparable years during 2021-2025. The leading recorded origins that year were Afghanistan (5,163), Syrian Arab Rep. (4,481), Somalia (1,004).

In 2025, the substantive protection rate was 63%, across 18,622 grants and refusals; closures accounted for 10% of all recorded decisions. That protection rate was 16.7 percentage points lower than in 2024 (80%).
